sources.summary: 404 Media 采访九名现任与离职 Proton 员工并查阅内部文件，报道 CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 转型引发的内部冲突。10 月公司 90% 代码由 AI 编写，多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude；Yen 称今年是最后一年招聘工程师，并宣布将以可能决定去留的重新面试评估员工 AI 使用情况。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 404 Media采访Proton 8名在职和1名前员工并查阅Slack记录，披露CEO Andy Yen内部强推AI，斥责要求先pentest的工程师为loser thinking，还以AI使用情况重审员工去留。

en.summary: 404 Media interviewed nine current and former Proton employees and reviewed internal documents, reporting on internal conflict sparked by CEO Andy Yen’s aggressive push for an AI transformation. In October, 90% of the company’s code was written by AI, mostly using Anthropic’s Claude; Yen said this year would be the last year Proton hires engineers and announced re-interviews to assess employees’ AI usage that could determine whether they stay.
en.reason: Proton CEO Andy Yen pushed an AI overhaul with 90% of October code written largely via Anthropic’s Claude, called pentest-seeking engineers “loser thinking,” and tied re-interviews to AI use and jobs, per 404 Media.

stories.title: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧 / Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong

sources.title: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧 / Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.title_zh: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧
sources.title_en: Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.title_original: Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.summary: 作者通读 Anthropic 公开版 S-1 文件，认为公司财务状况好于预期：2026 年第二季度收入从一季度的 47 亿美元增至 116 亿美元，并录得首个运营利润，截至 6 月底现金储备仅次于 Google 和 Berkshire Hathaway。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者读完Anthropic全部421页S-1，梳理出Q1营收47亿、Q2增至116亿美元并首次实现营业利润，Q3达168亿美元但增速放缓，以及已承诺向Amazon、Google等投入数千亿美元算力的细节。

en.summary: The author read through Anthropic's public S-1 and concludes the company's financials are better than expected: Q2 2026 revenue rose to $11.6 billion from $4.7 billion in Q1, marking its first operating profit, with cash reserves at the end of June second only to Google and Berkshire Hathaway.
en.reason: Anthropic's public S-1 shows revenue rising from $4.7 billion in Q1 to $11.6 billion in Q2 2026 with a first operating profit, $16.8 billion in Q3, and hundreds of billions committed to Amazon and Google compute.

stories.title: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进 / Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying

sources.title: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进 / Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.title_zh: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进
sources.title_en: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.title_original: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.summary: The Verge 作者分析 Anthropic S-1，认为其商业模式依赖高速增长：2026 上半年营收同比增长 14 倍至 $16.3 billion，净收入留存率 900%，但不可撤销采购承诺合计 $265.6 billion，加上未开始的租赁协议 $321.4 billion 及其他协议，未来 20 年承诺至少约 $850 billion。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借Anthropic的S-1拆解其商业计划：营收一年增14倍至163亿美元、调整后收入16.2亿美元，但固定成本迫使它押注Claude递归自我改进，且仅把OpenAI和Google列为对手。

en.summary: The Verge author analyzes Anthropic's S-1, arguing that its business model depends on rapid growth: H1 2026 revenue grew 14x year over year to $16.3 billion, with net revenue retention at 900%, but irrevocable purchase commitments total $265.6 billion, plus $321.4 billion in lease agreements that have not yet begun and other agreements, amounting to at least roughly $850 billion in commitments over the next 20 years.
en.reason: Anthropic’s S-1 shows 2026 H1 revenue up 14-fold to $16.3 billion against $265.6 billion in irrevocable commitments and $850 billion in 20-year obligations; The Verge argues its plan bets on Claude recursive self-improvement and names OpenAI and Google as rivals.

sources.title: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型 / Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!
sources.title_zh: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型
sources.title_en: Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!

sources.summary: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk（Mistral Large 4，1T 参数 MoE，52B 激活）的 Dynamic 1-bit GGUF，可在 Mac Studio 上本地运行，保留 91% top-1 准确率，体积约 233GB（较 1.1TB FP8 小 80%）。图为各量化档位给出硬件需求，1-bit 需 256-270GB 内存，最小 UD-IQ1_S 约占 233GB 磁盘，并支持文本与图像输入、1M 上下文和 160+ 语言。GGUF 与指南见 huggingface.co/unsloth/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-GGUF 和 unsloth.ai/docs/models/mistral-large-4。

stories.title: Google 三季度搜索增速不及预期，投资者担忧 AI 搜索变现拖累核心业务 / Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe

sources.title: Google 三季度搜索增速不及预期，投资者担忧 AI 搜索变现拖累核心业务 / Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
sources.title_zh: Google 三季度搜索增速不及预期，投资者担忧 AI 搜索变现拖累核心业务
sources.title_en: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
sources.title_original: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
sources.summary: Google 三季度搜索收入增长约 12%，低于分析师预期的 15%，市值一度缩水最多 10%。高管 Philipp Schindler 承认 AI mode 查询的强劲增长因变现率较低产生了影响，同时公司称搜索查询年增速达五年来最高，并计划在美国及国际市场扩大聊天机器人广告项目。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google 财报后股价一度跌10%，云收入翻倍至307亿美元但搜索收入仅增12%、低于预期的15%，公司承认AI mode查询增长快却变现较低，并计划在国际市场扩展AI mode广告。

en.summary: Google's Q3 search revenue rose about 12%, below analysts' 15% expectation, and its market cap fell by as much as 10% at one point. Executive Philipp Schindler acknowledged that strong growth in AI Mode queries weighed on results due to lower monetization, while the company said search query growth was the highest in five years and it plans to expand its chatbot advertising program in the US and international markets.
en.reason: Google’s search revenue grew about 12%, missing the 15% analysts expected, while its market value briefly fell as much as 10%; Philipp Schindler linked strong AI Mode query growth to lower monetization, and Google planned international chatbot ads.

sources.title: 纽约时报称中国情报人员瞄准英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋 / Chinese spies targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times
sources.title_zh: 纽约时报称中国情报人员瞄准英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋
sources.title_en: Chinese spies targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times
sources.title_original: Chinese spies targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times
sources.summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构认为英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋身边一名高管为中国提供情报，此人是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang（黄乐）。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 据《The New York Times》报道，美国情报机构认为 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 身边的 Alice Huang（黄乐）向北京传递信息，她是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 高管；其马来西亚姊妹公司曾在2024年6月至2026年2月间购入至少48亿美元含 Nvidia 芯片的 AI 硬件。

en.summary: According to The New York Times, U.S. intelligence agencies believe a senior executive in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's orbit has been providing intelligence to China: Alice Huang (Huang Le) of Singapore data center operator Megaspeed.
en.reason: US intelligence agencies reportedly believe Alice Huang (Huang Le), an executive at Singapore-based data center operator Megaspeed linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's circle, passed information to Beijing, per The New York Times, while her Malaysian sister company allegedly bought at least $4.8 billion in Nvidia-chip AI hardware between June 2024 and February 2026.

en.summary: Wiz analyzes the current state and trajectory of AI agents in real-world intrusions based on its own incident response work and publicly disclosed cases, covering frameworks such as ARTEX and Hermes and incidents including a South Korean financial institution (data on about 67,000 people exposed), Thailand’s Ministry of Finance, and the ConnectWise supply chain (attempted attacks on more than 2,250 tenants).
en.reason: Wiz links AI agent frameworks ARTEX and Hermes to real intrusions, including a South Korean financial firm's leak of about 67,000 people's data, Thailand's Ministry of Finance and ConnectWise supply-chain attempts on over 2,250 tenants.

sources.title_original: Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729
sources.summary: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 开源交互式视频世界模型的技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 数据集用于可复现研究。官方还用 Hy-Nomas 重现 Genie 4 示例并放出对比视频，演示无需排队即可试用，地址为 https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hy-Nomas 上周五发布技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 支持可复现研究，还用 Hy-Nomas 复现 Genie 4 示例并发布对比视频，邀请读者试用 demo。

en.summary: Tencent Hunyuan releases a technical report for Hy-Nomas, its open-source interactive video world model (arXiv:2610.36729), and open-sources the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research. The team also recreated Genie 4 examples with Hy-Nomas and released comparison videos; the demo can be tried without a waitlist at https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/.
en.reason: Tencent Hunyuan released the Hy-Nomas technical report (arXiv:2610.36729) last Friday, open-sourced the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research, and reproduced Genie 4 examples with comparison videos and a demo available to try.

items.summary: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 开源交互式视频世界模型的技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 数据集用于可复现研究。官方还用 Hy-Nomas 重现 Genie 4 示例并放出对比视频，演示无需排队即可试用，地址为 https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/。

en.summary: Tencent Hunyuan releases a technical report for Hy-Nomas, its open-source interactive video world model (arXiv:2610.36729), and open-sources the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research. The team also recreated Genie 4 examples with Hy-Nomas and released comparison videos; the demo can be tried without a waitlist at https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/.
en.reason: Tencent Hunyuan released the Hy-Nomas technical report (arXiv:2610.36729) last Friday, open-sourced the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research, and reproduced Genie 4 examples with comparison videos and a demo available to try.

en.title: Anthropic report: Claude research model finds vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux, stringing together 5 attack chains
en.summary: Anthropic released a research report on October 27 stating that an undisclosed internal Claude research model found vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux and chained them into five working attack chains; the vulnerabilities were reported and fixed through coordinated disclosure.
en.reason: Anthropic reported on 27 October that an undisclosed internal Claude research model found vulnerabilities across Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux and chained five working attack paths, including 62 high-severity Chrome CVEs and a Linux flaw yielding zero-click root in about 53 minutes.

stories.title: Addy Osmani 谈你可能对 Claude 过度提示了 / You're probably overprompting Claude

sources.title: Addy Osmani 谈你可能对 Claude 过度提示了 / You're probably overprompting Claude
sources.title_zh: Addy Osmani 谈你可能对 Claude 过度提示了
sources.title_en: You're probably overprompting Claude
sources.title_original: You're probably overprompting Claude
sources.summary: Addy Osmani 撰文称新版 Claude 模型所需提示词比多数人习惯的更少，针对 Opus 5.5 建议用单一明确目标加验证条件让 Claude 自主工作，从 /effort medium 起步按需调整。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章指出新模型无需过度提示：Claude Opus 5 和 Claude Fable 5 移除超过80%的 Claude Code system prompt 后编码评测无可测退化，建议给 Opus 5.5 单一目标和验证方式、从 /effort medium 起步。

en.summary: Addy Osmani writes that the new Claude models require fewer prompts than most people are used to. For Opus 5.5, he recommends giving a single clear goal plus verification conditions and letting Claude work autonomously, starting at /effort medium and adjusting as needed.
en.reason: Stripping over 80% of the Claude Code system prompt from Claude Opus 5 and Claude Fable 5 caused no measurable coding regression, so Addy Osmani advises giving Opus 5.5 one goal with verification and starting at /effort medium.

sources.title: Gemini 新增文档、PDF、演示文稿和表格的直接生成、预览与编辑功能 / You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.

sources.title_en: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
sources.title_original: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
sources.summary: Google Gemini 宣布可直接在应用内生成、预览和编辑文档、PDF、演示文稿、表格等多种文件。支持把手写笔记转成 PDF 学习指南、手动调整内容、高亮部分让 Gemini 修改文字或视觉元素，并可继续追问。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Gemini 现在可以直接生成、预览并编辑文档、PDF、演示文稿和表格，还能把手写笔记一键变成 PDF 学习指南，并可圈选段落让 Gemini 修改文字或画面、继续追问。

en.summary: Google Gemini now lets you generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and other files directly in the app. It can turn handwritten notes into PDF study guides, let you manually adjust content, highlight sections for Gemini to revise text or visual elements, and continue asking follow-up questions.
en.reason: Google Gemini now generates, previews and edits documents, PDFs, presentations and spreadsheets in-app, can turn handwritten notes into a PDF study guide, and lets users highlight sections for Gemini to revise text or visuals.

sources.title_original: Codex 宣布即日起 Pro 及 Business Premium 各档位用量上限翻倍
sources.summary: Tibo 宣布即日起将 Pro 100/200/500 档位与 Business Premium 的所有用量上限翻倍。Pro 200 的上限不会下调，Work 与 Codex 用量保持不变；dots 的扩展用量上限继续提供，且仍与默认用量分开计算，后续还会通过更好的模型和效率改进提升实际可用量。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Codex 宣布即日起将 Pro 100/200/500 全部档位及 Business Premium 的用量上限翻倍，并回应反馈不再下调 Pro 200，Work 与 Codex 用量维持不变。

en.title: Codex announces that, effective immediately, usage limits are doubled across all Pro and Business Premium tiers.
en.summary: Tibo announced that, effective immediately, all usage limits across the Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium are being doubled. The Pro 200 limit will not be reduced, and Work and Codex usage remain unchanged. dots' extended usage limits will continue to be available and are still counted separately from default usage, with future gains in actual usable capacity to come from better models and efficiency improvements.
en.reason: Codex immediately doubles all usage limits for the Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 tiers plus Business Premium, and reverses course on Pro 200 by keeping its cap unchanged while Work and Codex usage stay as is.

stories.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 LLM 从 PDF 中抽取表格 / How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM

sources.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 LLM 从 PDF 中抽取表格 / How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
sources.title_zh: OpenRouter 教程：用 LLM 从 PDF 中抽取表格
sources.title_en: How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
sources.title_original: How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
sources.summary: OpenRouter 发布教程，讲解如何把 PDF 以文件形式连同严格 JSON schema 发给能读文件的模型，让表格以带类型的行返回，括号亏损、千分位和脚注标记等清理都写进字段描述。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用 Python 将 PDF 和严格 JSON schema 发给可读文件的 LLM，在五份测试 PDF（含两份扫描）中验证 644 个单元格全对，并指出 PDF 传入路径会造成两种不报错失败。

en.summary: OpenRouter published a tutorial on sending a PDF as a file, along with a strict JSON schema, to a file-reading model so tables come back as typed rows, with cleanup for parenthetical negatives, thousands separators, and footnote markers spelled out in the field descriptions.
en.reason: Python sends a PDF plus strict JSON schema to a file-reading LLM, returning typed table rows; OpenRouter's tutorial reports 644 cells all correct across five test PDFs, two scanned, but two silent failures from PDF input paths.

stories.title: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103% / Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.

sources.title: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103% / Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.title_zh: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103%
sources.title_en: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.title_original: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.summary: Sundar Pichai 发布 Alphabet Q3 业绩：年化收入 run rate 达 5000 亿美元，总收入同比增长 25%。Google Cloud 收入增长 103%，1P 模型 API 每分钟处理近 32B tokens（环比增 40%）；Search 查询同比增速为五年来最高，并提到 Argon、Carbon 领跑前沿及最新世界模型 Genie 4。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet Q3财报显示年化营收规模达half-trillion美元、营收同比增长25%，AI投入推动Search整体及商业查询增长，同比查询增速为近五年最高。

en.summary: Sundar Pichai reports Alphabet Q3 results: annualized revenue run rate reaches $500 billion, total revenue up 25% year over year. Google Cloud revenue grew 103%, with 1P model APIs processing nearly 32B tokens per minute (up 40% quarter over quarter); Search query growth was the fastest year-over-year in five years, and he noted Argon and Carbon leading the frontier along with the latest world model, Genie 4.
en.reason: Alphabet’s Q3 revenue grew 25% to a half-trillion-dollar annual run rate, with Google Cloud up 103% and first-party model APIs handling nearly 32B tokens per minute, as Search query growth hit a five-year high.

primary_item.title_en: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
primary_item.title_original: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
primary_item.summary: Sundar Pichai 发布 Alphabet Q3 业绩：年化收入 run rate 达 5000 亿美元，总收入同比增长 25%。Google Cloud 收入增长 103%，1P 模型 API 每分钟处理近 32B tokens（环比增 40%）；Search 查询同比增速为五年来最高，并提到 Argon、Carbon 领跑前沿及最新世界模型 Genie 4。
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet Q3财报显示年化营收规模达half-trillion美元、营收同比增长25%，AI投入推动Search整体及商业查询增长，同比查询增速为近五年最高。

en.summary: Sundar Pichai reports Alphabet Q3 results: annualized revenue run rate reaches $500 billion, total revenue up 25% year over year. Google Cloud revenue grew 103%, with 1P model APIs processing nearly 32B tokens per minute (up 40% quarter over quarter); Search query growth was the fastest year-over-year in five years, and he noted Argon and Carbon leading the frontier along with the latest world model, Genie 4.
en.reason: Alphabet’s Q3 revenue grew 25% to a half-trillion-dollar annual run rate, with Google Cloud up 103% and first-party model APIs handling nearly 32B tokens per minute, as Search query growth hit a five-year high.

stories.title: vLLM 发布 Mistral Large 4 Day 0 支持 / Day 0 support for Mistral Large 4 on vLLM

sources.title: vLLM 发布 Mistral Large 4 Day 0 支持 / Day 0 support for Mistral Large 4 on vLLM
sources.title_zh: vLLM 发布 Mistral Large 4 Day 0 支持
sources.title_en: Day 0 support for Mistral Large 4 on vLLM
sources.title_original: Day 0 support for Mistral Large 4 on vLLM
sources.summary: vLLM 团队宣布对 Mistral 新旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4 提供 Day 0 支持，该模型为 1T 参数、每 token 激活 49B 的原生多模态 MoE 模型，采用 MLA 稀疏注意力加 DSA top-k 索引器、跨层 KV 共享、NoPE、SSMax 和 LeRoPE 等新架构，并内置 DSpark 推测解码草稿器与 Pixtral 视觉编码器。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: vLLM为Mistral Large 4提供Day-0支持，集成跨层KV共享，NVFP4在Blackwell 4 GPU上相对FP8差距不超过2.1分。

en.summary: The vLLM team announced Day 0 support for Mistral's new flagship model, Mistral Large 4. The model is a 1T-parameter native multimodal MoE with 49B active parameters per token, featuring a new architecture that includes MLA sparse attention with a DSA top-k indexer, cross-layer KV sharing, NoPE, SSMax, and LeRoPE, plus a built-in DSpark speculative decoding drafter and Pixtral vision encoder.
en.reason: vLLM adds Day-0 support for Mistral Large 4, a 1T-parameter native multimodal MoE activating 49B parameters per token, with cross-layer KV sharing and NVFP4 on Blackwell 4 GPUs trailing FP8 by at most 2.1 points.

stories.title: 总部位于巴黎的 Mistral 发布编程模型“Le Chonk”，能力不俗，但整体仍落后于中国 / Paris-based Mistral releases "Le Chonk," a strong coding model that still trails China overall

sources.title: 总部位于巴黎的 Mistral 发布编程模型“Le Chonk”，能力不俗，但整体仍落后于中国 / Paris-based Mistral releases "Le Chonk," a strong coding model that still trails China overall
sources.title_zh: 总部位于巴黎的 Mistral 发布编程模型“Le Chonk”，能力不俗，但整体仍落后于中国
sources.title_en: Paris-based Mistral releases "Le Chonk," a strong coding model that still trails China overall
sources.title_original: Paris-based Mistral releases "Le Chonk," a strong coding model that still trails China overall
sources.summary:
Mistral has released the weights for Large 4, aka "Le Chonk," a trillion-parameter model trained entirely in Europe. Mistral says it beats its open rivals at coding, and independent testing shows it's fast and fairly cheap. It still can't match China's top models, scoring 26 points to the 32 posted by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3.
Mistral has released the weights for Large 4, aka "Le Chonk," a trillion-parameter model trained entirely in Europe. Mistral says it beats its open rivals at coding
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Mistral开放万亿参数Large 4权重，强化学习使其Terminal-Bench 4.0从28%升至41%，但整体26分仍落后中国头部模型的32分。

en.reason: Mistral's open-weight Large 4, a trillion-parameter model trained entirely in Europe, lifts Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 28% to 41% through reinforcement learning but still scores 26 overall against 32 for China's DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3.

en.title: AI EDA enters its validation phase, bringing three changes across the industry chain. EDA (chip design automation software) is evolving from a "tool" into an "agent": AI EDA uses AI agents to take over the time-consuming "design—verify—modify" loop in chip design, and AI EDA has now entered its validation phase.
en.reason: Synopsys has mapped AI EDA onto an autonomous-driving-style L1–L5 scale and this year demonstrated L3–L4 multi-agent workflows spanning natural-language RTL generation and automated verification convergence, with measured efficiency gains of several times, as the piece maps the industry's three shifts from point tools to agent platforms.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: NYT Cooking 正测试 AI 改食谱功能，高级编辑 Genevieve Ko 称可替换食材、按份数缩放并适配不同锅具；示例建议用 baby spinach 替代 kale 时后放，该功能已向 iOS 端所有 Cooking 订阅者开放，却因环保与体验争议关闭评论。

en.reason: NYT Cooking is testing an AI feature that senior editor Genevieve Ko says swaps ingredients, scales servings and adapts to cookware—e.g., adding baby spinach after kale—open to iOS Cooking subscribers but with comments closed amid controversy.

stories.title: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制

sources.title: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制
sources.title_zh: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制
sources.title_original: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制
sources.summary: 这篇文章深度拆解了线性注意力从 DeltaNet、GDN 到 KDA 的演进脉络，同时落地到 vLLM 里 Hybrid 混合模型的缓存工程实现，帮你看懂模型架构和推理调度之间的软硬件取舍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 3万字长文从Prefill/Decode访存差异讲到KVCache的O(N)瓶颈，并沿DeltaNet、GDN到KDA梳理线性注意力的Chunk-wise并行。

en.title: AI Infra Deep Dive: Understanding Linear Attention Mechanisms in 30,000 Words
en.summary: This article takes a deep dive into the evolution of linear attention from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA, then grounds it in the cache engineering behind hybrid models in vLLM, helping you understand the hardware-software trade-offs between model architecture and inference scheduling.
en.reason: Linear attention's evolution from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA is traced across a 30,000-character analysis that starts with Prefill/Decode memory-access differences and the O(N) KV Cache bottleneck, then lands in vLLM's Hybrid model cache implementation and Chunk-wise parallelism.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇讲 Apache 2.0 开源的 OpenMausBot 如何把 AI 做成聊天应用：每个机器人由本地 Claude 或 Codex 驱动，拥有独立模型、云电脑和 Gmail、Slack、GitHub 等应用，并用权限代理把危险操作变成 Allow/Deny 决策。

en.reason: Apache 2.0-licensed OpenMausBot turns AI into a chat app where each bot runs on local Claude or Codex with its own model, cloud computer, Gmail/Slack/GitHub access, and a permission proxy that converts dangerous operations into Allow/Deny decisions.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Opera 推出 WebAI，允许网站直接调用运行在用户自己电脑上的 AI 模型，算力不再全部依赖云端；这一设计把浏览器、网站与本地模型之间的权限和隐私边界推到台前。

en.reason: Opera's WebAI lets websites call AI models running on the user's own computer rather than relying entirely on cloud compute, raising new questions about permissions and privacy boundaries between browsers, sites and local models.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Instagram负责人Adam Mosseri在Colin and Samir播客中判断，围绕AI的焦虑与愤怒未来几年还会加剧，不只创意行业；他认为根源是害怕被落下，并提到Instagram已要求AI账号自我标注、但不打算全面禁止AI内容。

en.reason: Instagram head Adam Mosseri told the Colin and Samir podcast that anger and anxiety around AI will keep worsening over the next few years, driven by fear of being left behind and extending beyond creative industries, while Instagram requires AI accounts to label themselves rather than banning AI content outright.

stories.title: 我盯AI交易工具盯了一年多了 大部分产品卷的都是同一件事 能接几个市场、能跑几个模型、策略谁更牛 但我越来越觉得，瓶颈不在这 在一个人第一次打开产品的那五分钟 不知道该干嘛，关了，再也不回来 最近 @questflow 整个界面重做了 这次让我停下来的不是又加了什么 是它在改那五分钟 // 新用户完成引导之后，可以立刻创建第一个Agent 不是先看教程、先绑钱包、先选模型 直接创一个 监控市场异动、推送突发新闻，选好范围它就跑 我觉得…

en.title: I've been watching AI trading tools for over a year now. Most products are all competing on the same things: how many markets they connect to, how many models they can run, whose strategy is better. But I've come to believe the bottleneck isn't there. It's the five minutes after someone first opens the product — they don't know what to do, they close it, and they never come back. @questflow recently rebuilt its entire interface. What made me stop this time wasn't something new it added — it's that it's reworking those five minutes. // After new users finish onboarding, they can immediately create their first Agent. No watching a tutorial first, no connecting a wallet first, no picking a model first — just create one: monitor market moves…
en.reason: Questflow’s redesign lets new users create their first Agent immediately after onboarding—no tutorial, wallet binding or model selection first—tasking it to monitor market moves and push breaking news within a chosen scope.
